questions.question: Dadasaheb Phalke International Film Festival Award 2024 for the Best Film was given to which of the following movies?
What was the ranking of India in the Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) for 2024, as per the Transparency International report released in February 2025?
Javagal Srinath is known as _____ of India.
अप्रैल 2025 में पारित किस विधि का उद्देश्य भुगतान में चूक की स्थिति में वायुयान पट्टेदारों को पुनः कब्ज़ा दिलाने की सुविधा प्रदान करके उनके अधिकारों की रक्षा करना है?
options: वायुयान वस्तुओं में हित संरक्षण विधेयक (Protection of Interests in Aircraft Objects Bill)
अंतरराष्ट्रीय वायुयान पट्टा अधिनियम (International Aircraft Leasing Act)
विमानन परिसंपत्तियों की वसूली विधेयक (Aviation Assets Recovery Bill)
वायुयान पट्टा सुविधा अधिनियम (Aircraft Leasing Facilitation Act)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (वायुयान वस्तुओं में हित संरक्षण विधेयक (Protection of Interests in Aircraft Objects Bill)) है।

questions.question: The Mesolithic site of Langhnaj is located on one of the numerous sand dunes in Mehsana district of _____ state of India.
Which of the following is/are the methods to obtain Indian citizenship?I. By birthII. By registrationIII. By naturalisationIV. By descent
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (I, II, III and IV) है।

questions.question: Which of the following amounts of corpus was set up by the government in 2024 for long-term financing to encourage innovation and research?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (₹1 lakh crore) है।

questions.question: Which of the following state governments introduced the 'School on Wheels' program, aiming to provide education to students sheltered in relief camps across the state?
Which city's team emerged as the women's champion in the 13th Junior Punjab Baseball Championship?
Which Indian athlete won a gold medal in the 42km marathon at the 2025 World Speed Skating Championships?
CAR-T cell therapy primarily treats which of the following categories of disease?
Vaishali pillar inscription of Ashoka is presently located in which of the following states of India?
What does the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) mean?
options: Value of total output of consumption goods and investment goods
Average income of the people of a country in a particular year
Total value of goods and services produced within the country during a year
Value of net output of the economy during the year
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Total value of goods and services produced within the country during a year) है।

questions.question: कौटिल्य के अर्थशास्त्र में पाठ के आरंभ में _________ का अभिवादन किया गया है।
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (शुक्र और बृहस्पति) है।

questions.question: Which of the following Indian space scientists were honoured with prestigious awards on 15 July 2024 by the Committee on Space Research (COSPAR), the world’s first scientific body dedicated to space science research?
options: Prahlad Chandra Agrawal and Anil Bhardwaj
AE Muthunayagam and G Madhavan Nair
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Prahlad Chandra Agrawal and Anil Bhardwaj) है।

questions.question: With which sport is Koneru Humpy associated?
Which of the following films won the Best Feature Film award at the 69th National Award in 2023?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Rocketry: The Nambi Effect) है।

questions.question: Which of following secured the first position in the medal tally at the 38th National Games concluded in Uttarakhand?
Which technology is described as self-emissive, flexible, and used in modern mobile displays?
संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत किसी राज्य के विधानमंडल को 'राज्य सूची' में सूचीबद्ध किसी भी मामले के संबंध में उस राज्य या उसके किसी भाग के लिए कानून बनाने की विशेष शक्ति प्राप्त है?
